Just a few minutes’ walk from Hoan Kiem Lake, our hotel offers easy access to Hanoi’s historic streets, local restaurants, cultural landmarks and popular shopping areas. Our location allows guests to stay close to the energy of the Old Quarter while enjoying a calm and comfortable place to rest. Whether you are visiting Hanoi with family, travelling as a couple, exploring Vietnam on your own or arranging accommodation for a group, Hanoi Stella Hotel provides a convenient base for your journey. Stay Close to Hoan Kiem Lake and Hanoi’s Old Quarter From Hanoi Stella Hotel, guests can easily explore many of the city’s best-known attractions on foot. Hoan Kiem Lake , Ngoc Son Temple , Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre , Hanoi Old Quarter Night Market and Ta Hien Street are all within easy reach. The hotel is also conveniently connected to Nguyen Huu Huan, Tran Nhat Duat and Tran Quang Khai streets . These nearby routes provide access to bus offices and pick-up points for journeys to Ha Long Bay, Ha Giang, Sapa, Ninh Binh and other destinations in Northern Vietnam . This makes Hanoi Stella Hotel a practical choice for travellers who want to explore Hanoi before continuing their journey across Vietnam. For additional tour combos, please check out our trusted partner, AZOTOUR . Comfortable Rooms for Every Kind of Traveller Our rooms are designed to provide a relaxing retreat after a day of sightseeing. Each room combines modern comfort with warm Asian-inspired details and is equipped with essential amenities for a convenient stay. Guests can choose from a variety of room types suitable for: Solo travellers and business guests Couples visiting Hanoi Families travelling with children Groups and long-stay guests Selected rooms also feature windows, balconies, city views or bathtubs. Whatever room you choose, our team aims to provide a clean, peaceful and comfortable environment throughout your stay. Check our our room options here . Warm and Personal Hospitality At Hanoi Stella Hotel, hospitality is about more than providing a room. Our friendly team is available to assist with local recommendations, airport transfers, bus bookings, tours and travel arrangements. Guided by our motto, “Home is where the heart is”, we want every guest to feel welcomed, cared for and at ease. Many travellers return to stay with us on their next visit to Hanoi, and we are always delighted to welcome familiar faces back. Experience Hanoi at Your Own Pace Staying at Hanoi Stella Hotel gives you the freedom to experience the city in a way that suits your travel style. Start the morning with a walk around Hoan Kiem Lake, discover local cafés and traditional Vietnamese food in the surrounding streets, or explore the heritage buildings and cultural attractions of the nearby Old and French Quarters. The hotel’s central location makes it easy to return for a short rest before continuing your day. Families can enjoy a convenient base close to Hanoi’s main attractions, while couples and solo travellers can explore the neighbourhood on foot without spending too much time arranging transport. Group guests also benefit from straightforward access to major roads and nearby pick-up points. Our team understands that every journey is different. Some guests visit Hanoi for a short city break, while others stay before travelling to Ha Long Bay, Sapa, Ha Giang or Ninh Binh. We are always happy to provide local suggestions and help guests find suitable travel arrangements. At the end of the day, return to a comfortable and welcoming space where you can relax, recharge and prepare for your next Hanoi experience.
